conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Now, trends can originate from anywhere and be amplified globally almost instantly through social media, whereas previously, they often spread more regionally and through traditional media outlets. This immediate global reach is a significant difference.
